# Edgar A. Dikenge

> Software Engineer & Integration Consultant based in Luanda, Angola, with continuous production experience since 2020. Specializing in pragmatic software architecture, enterprise integrations, microservices, API security, and high-performance backend systems.

## Professional Summary

Edgar A. Dikenge is a Software Engineer with consolidated experience since 2020 developing and evolving robust, high-performance digital solutions. Passionate about transforming complex ideas into efficient, scalable systems, he rigorously applies engineering best practices, Clean Code, and Design Patterns to guarantee software maintainability and quality.

Edgar works proficiently with TypeScript (Nest.js), Python, Java, and C/C++, building resilient APIs, microservices, and enterprise backend integrations. His expertise spans legacy system refactoring, process automation, Git workflows, and deployment across Docker and Kubernetes (K8s) environments. He is known for technical autonomy, collaborative leadership, and results-driven architecture design that aligns technology with business objectives.

Currently, Edgar serves as Software Engineer & Integration Consultant at Nossa Seguros, designing enterprise integration solutions, MuleSoft API-led connectivity over the legacy Cleva Insurance Platform, secure REST APIs with OAuth2/JWT authentication, and automated CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.

## Core Engineering Principles & Thesis

1. **Resilience & Pragmatic Trade-offs:** There are no silver-bullet architectures. Modular monoliths, microservices, or BFF layers must be selected based on real trade-offs: team topology, operational costs, network latency, and idempotency requirements.
2. **Security & Best Practices by Design:** Security and code quality cannot be afterthoughts. Clean Code, proven Design Patterns, strong authentication (OAuth2/JWT), input sanitization, and automated integration testing are foundational prerequisites for production software.
3. **Seamless Modernization without Rupture:** Modern integration layers and strategic refactoring build an optimal bridge between agile interfaces and mission-critical legacy systems that cannot experience downtime.
